headline: Alibaba has put the downloadable files of its 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8 model on Hugging Face for anyone to use under a custom licence.
score_reason: Lowered from 7: the 'largest open-source model' claim in the headline is not backed by a comparison, and the facts come from one secondary outlet.
importance_line: Researchers and companies can test a very large Chinese model on their own hardware, but big commercial users face licence conditions and the model still needs data-centre-scale systems, and the ranking claims come from a single outlet.
summary: TechJuice reports that Alibaba released the text-only open-weight version of its Qwen3.8-Max model, meaning its trained files can be downloaded; it has 2.4 trillion parameters (the adjustable numbers inside a model) but uses only about 95 billion for each request, which is meant to keep computing costs down. It comes under a custom licence that sets conditions for large commercial users, and TechJuice calls it the largest open-source model without comparing it against others.
notes: Exact upload date not given; reported 9 Oct 2026.
